## Services

- Web development: responsive websites tailored to business needs.
- WhatsApp bot deployment: business communication and automation, from KSh 70 per month.
- WiFi solutions: hotspot packages and home internet packages.
- Custom systems: software and systems designed around practical needs.
- Social App: a WhatsApp-style web app to find new friends, advertise products, and chat.

## WiFi package prices

Hotspot: free 3 minutes (KSh 0), 1 hour (KSh 10), 3 hours (KSh 20), 6 hours (KSh 30), 12 hours (KSh 40), 24 hours (KSh 50), 1 week (KSh 250), and 1 month (KSh 600).

Home packages: 4 Mbps (KSh 800 per month) and 7 Mbps (KSh 1,000 per month).
